pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 32497-32509 (label lemma-geometrically-normal-fibres-universally-catenary, canonical tag 0C2F): a Noetherian local ring with geometrically normal formal fibres has universally catenary henselization, and is itself universally catenary when unibranch. The proof environment at source lines 32511-32523 immediately follows it and is its own proof: the equality of branch numbers for the ring and its completion feeds the branch-count criterion, which gives the uniqueness of the minimal prime of the completion of the henselization modulo a minimal prime, i.e. formal catenarity, whence universal catenarity by the Ratliff criterion; in the unibranch case the uniqueness is transferred to the ring and the criterion applied again.
